faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started

q1.question: Is it really free? What's the catch?
q1.answer: Yes, it's 100% free! There's no catch. Athlifyr is a platform built to connect fitness communities and help professionals grow their business. All management features are completely free - no hidden costs, no premium tiers.

q2.question: How long does it take to set up?
q2.answer: You can have your space set up in less than 10 minutes. Just create an account, add your venue's basic information, set up your services and schedules, and you're ready!

q3.question: Can I import my existing clients?
q3.answer: Yes! You can import your client base via CSV file or add them manually. You can also invite your clients to join the platform directly.

q4.question: Do my clients need to create an account?
q4.answer: Clients can create a free Athlifyr account for full access: book classes, view schedules, pay subscriptions and track their progress. But you can also manage clients who don't have an account.

q5.question: Can I use my own branding and colors?
q5.answer: Of course! You can customize your venue page with your logo, colors, photos and all relevant information. Your clients see your brand, not ours.

q6.question: What if I need help?
q6.answer: You have access to email support and our complete documentation. We're here to help you get the most out of the platform.

q7.question: Can I cancel at any time?
q7.answer: Absolutely! There are no contracts or commitments. You can export all your data and leave whenever you want. But we're sure you'll love staying!

q8.question: What payment methods can I accept?
q8.answer: Through Stripe integration, you can accept credit/debit cards, bank transfers and more. Payments go directly to your account.
